entry.author: Pāmu™
entry.summary:
At Pāmu, farming is what we do and what we're great at. We’ve spent over 130 years getting to know New Zealand farms. We’re the largest, oldest, and most diversified farming company in the country. We manage over 100 farms and have corporate offices in both Wellington and Auckland. From the sunny hills of Northland to the rugged hills of Southland, our people can grow and develop their farming skills over several locations nationwide ... some staff have worked with us at different locations spanning decades!

We have defined career pathways for our people in all areas of our business so that you can learn, develop, and advance. And we always look to promote internally, first. We look out for the health, safety, and well-being of all our staff with modern, well-maintained facilities and farm equipment. We value teamwork and collaboration, promoting a close-knit environment to keep our teams engaged. We’re natural innovators who apply fresh thinking throughout the product journey, from the paddock to the plate and every step in between.

Farming can be a wild ride but it’s an adventure like no other. No matter which path you want to take with your career, there’s a place for you at Pāmu. Do you want to be a part of the new future of farming? Come and join us!
